title: $D^{2}R^{2}$: Discrete Diffusion with Regulation Reinforcement for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.15288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting single-cell transcriptomic responses to genetic perturbations is central to functional genomics and virtual-cell modeling. Existing approaches, however, typically predict an entire expression profile as a whole, leaving the order in which individual gene responses are generated unmodeled. To address this problem, we introduce \textbf{$D^{2}R^{2}$} (\textbf{D}iscrete \textbf{D}iffusion with \textbf{R}egulation \textbf{R}einforcement), which reformulates perturbation prediction as regulation-guided gene-wise progressive generation. A Masked Discrete Diffusion Model represents expression as ordinal tokens and reconstructs a fully masked profile step by step, allowing generated gene responses to condition those that remain masked. A Regulatory Policy Module initializes the generation policy from a gene regulatory network inferred from control cells and adapts it to the perturbation and current partially generated state. translated_title: $D^{2}R^{2}$：基于调控强化学习的离散扩散模型用于单细胞扰动预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15288v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：预测单细胞对遗传扰动的转录组反应是功能基因组学和虚拟细胞建模的核心问题。然而，现有方法通常将整个表达谱作为一个整体进行预测，未对单个基因反应生成的顺序进行建模。为解决这一问题，我们提出了$D^{2}R^{2}$（离散扩散与调控强化学习），它将扰动预测重新定义为调控引导的基因逐级渐进生成过程。一个掩蔽离散扩散模型将表达表示为有序令牌，并逐步重建完全掩蔽的表达谱，使已生成的基因反应能够条件化影响仍处于掩蔽状态的基因。一个调控策略模块从对照细胞推断出的基因调控网络初始化生成策略，并根据扰动和当前部分生成状态进行自适应调整。随后，分组...
tldr: 本文提出$D^{2}R^{2}$模型，首次将单细胞扰动预测转化为调控引导的基因逐级生成过程，通过离散扩散模型和调控强化学习，显式建模基因反应生成顺序，从而更准确地预测转录组响应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces $D^{2}R^{2}$, which reformulates single-cell perturbation prediction as regulation-guided gene-wise progressive generation, explicitly modeling the order of gene responses via discrete diffusion and regulation reinforcement for more accurate transcriptomic predictions.
